$comment: Completion bar for #120: the notes rail no longer floods with transcript chunks and gains filter/sort. useNotes derives visibleItems (hides kind=transcript by default, toggleable; filter-as-you-type on title/body/summary/project; sort by updated/title/created). The rail gets a 'Filter notes' input, a Sort select and a Transcripts toggle. Find gains 'Show more' pagination (findLimit + loadMoreHits). Transcript grouping into one expandable row per media project is left as a follow-up (this bar implements hide-by-default, the issue's accepted alternative).

criteria.target: grep -q "visibleItems" src/hooks/useNotes.ts && grep -q "showTranscripts" src/hooks/useNotes.ts && grep -q "loadMoreHits" src/hooks/useNotes.ts && grep -q "Filter notes" src/features/NotesRail.tsx && grep -q "Show more" src/features/FindPanel.tsx
